data.name: ChooseTunnelMethod
data.value: Choose how the tunnel is opened.

data.name: CommandNeedsLocalPort
data.value: The command must contain {0}, where the local port goes.
data.comment: {0} is the literal placeholder {port} the user types into the command.

data.name: CommandUnclosedQuote
data.value: The command has an unclosed quote.

data.name: InstanceConnectionNameFormat
data.value: Instance connection name must be project:region:instance.

data.name: KubernetesResourceRequired
data.value: A Kubernetes resource is required, such as service/postgres.

data.name: ListSeparator
data.comment: Joins the names of the enabled connection methods.

data.name: LocalPortRange
data.value: Local port must be between 1 and 65535.

data.name: OnlyOneTransport
data.value: A connection can use only one connection method at a time. Enabled: {0}.
data.comment: {0} lists the connection methods that are turned on.

data.name: ProxyPortRange
data.value: Proxy port must be between 1 and 65535.

data.name: SshHostRequired
data.value: Enter the SSH host, or turn the tunnel off.

data.name: SsmTargetRequired
data.value: An SSM target is required, such as i-0123456789abcdef0.

data.name: TransportUnavailable
data.comment: {0} is an engine name, {1} a connection method such as SSH Tunnel.

data.name: TunnelFieldInvalid
data.value: {0} cannot start with a dash or contain spaces.
data.comment: {0} is the name of a tunnel field, such as Namespace.
